import json, os, re, urllib.request, urllib.error
raw = os.environ["BLAND_API_KEY"].strip()
if raw.startswith("{"):
    p = json.loads(raw); raw = next((p[k] for k in ("api_key", "key", "value") if p.get(k)), raw)
AGENT = "+15095611012"; RACHEL_TAIL = "8942428"
mask = lambda s: re.sub(r"\d{5,}", lambda m: "***" + m.group(0)[-4:], str(s))

def call(path):
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.bland.ai" + path, headers={"Authorization": raw, "Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:200]

print("=== RACHEL THREAD ===")
st, listing = call("/v1/sms/conversations?limit=100")
rows = listing if isinstance(listing, list) else (listing.get("data") or listing.get("conversations") or [])
mine = [c for c in rows if isinstance(c, dict) and str(c.get("agent_number", "")) == AGENT and str(c.get("user_number", "")).endswith(RACHEL_TAIL)]
print("LIST HTTP %s rachel_convs=%d" % (st, len(mine)))
if not mine:
    print("NO_RACHEL_CONVERSATIONS")
for c in mine:
    cid = str(c.get("conversation_id", c.get("id", "")))
    print("CONV ...%s status=%s node=%s updated=%s" % (cid[-6:], c.get("status"), c.get("current_node_id"), str(c.get("updated_at", c.get("created_at", "")))[:19]))
    msgs = None
    st2, detail = call("/v1/sms/conversations/%s" % cid)
    if isinstance(detail, dict):
        d = detail.get("data") if isinstance(detail.get("data"), dict) else detail
        for k in ("messages", "message_history", "history"):
            if isinstance(d.get(k), list):
                msgs = d[k]; break
    if msgs is None:
        st3, mlist = call("/v1/sms/conversations/%s/messages" % cid)
        if isinstance(mlist, list):
            msgs = mlist
        elif isinstance(mlist, dict):
            cand = mlist.get("data") or mlist.get("messages")
            msgs = cand if isinstance(cand, list) else None
    if not isinstance(msgs, list):
        print("  MESSAGES_UNAVAILABLE detail_http=%s" % st2)
        continue
    print("  MESSAGES: %d" % len(msgs))
    for m in msgs:
        if not isinstance(m, dict):
            continue
        who = m.get("role") or m.get("direction") or m.get("sender") or "?"
        ts = str(m.get("created_at", m.get("timestamp", "")))[:19]
        txt = mask(str(m.get("text", m.get("content", m.get("body", ""))))[:400])
        print("  [%s] %s: %s" % (ts, who, txt))
print("RACHEL_THREAD_DONE")
